title: Invariant for fan-out reduction
statement: For a natural number $n$, an original gate list, and a state consisting of a gate list, a vertex map, and a counter, the invariant requires that the counter equal $n$ plus the length of the original list; the new gate list be acyclic; and every original vertex index map below $n$ plus the original list length to a vertex below $n$ plus the new gate-list length, with distinct original indices mapping to distinct vertices. It also requires that, for every assignment of Boolean values to the $n$ input vertices, evaluation at each mapped original vertex agrees with the output of the original circuit on that assignment; every vertex have fan-out at most two; each mapped original vertex have fan-out zero; every new gate have distinct arguments and have exactly one argument if it is a negation gate and exactly two otherwise; and the new list have length at most five times the original list length.
hypotheses_covered: state consisting of a gate list, a vertex map, and a counter
